decomposed (NFD) input is composed before matching
rules match case-insensitively
a pack without rules returns the text untouched (fixRecognition)
a pack without rules returns the text untouched (forTranslation)
a rule with a context applies when the context is present
a rule with a context does nothing without the context
atClauseStart hands the punctuation back as $1
whole words only: a letter or digit touching the match blocks it
dialect: \d matches an ASCII digit (price context)
dialect: \d does not match an Arabic-Indic digit
dialect: \d does not match a fullwidth digit
dialect: the pattern is grouped before the bounds are added
template: $0 is the whole match, a group that does not exist is empty
